autotest: shard_client: upload a maximum of 1k jobs per heartbeat In a recent lab outage, shard heartbeats that were trying to upload >10k aborted jobs from multiple shards appeared to cause cascading failure (or slow recovery from failure) on shard heartbeats throughout the fleet. When working normally, shards never seem to exceed 1k jobs uploaded per heartbeat. Even if they need to exceed this for short periods of time, setting a limit of 1k only means it will take a few extra ticks to do so, and seems a good tradeoff to make in exchange for protection from cascading failure.
